title: From almost quitting to our first user
goal: Tell a short, truthful lesson about customer discovery
editor_notes: Check whether the transition from the setback to the teacher needs a title card.

clips.title: The setback
clips.source_text: We almost closed the company. It was the hardest week of the year. We had built a product without speaking to a single customer.

clips.title: Talk to users
clips.source_text: So we stopped coding for a week and started asking questions. One teacher told us she needed feedback for her students immediately. We built a tiny demo that same evening and showed it to her.

clips.title: The lesson
clips.quote: We needed to listen before we built anything.
clips.source_text: The next morning she asked when she could use it in her class. The lesson was simple. We needed to listen before we built anything.
